text:
Maria Chen: FYI — ACME tenant go-live next Tue. I sketched an orchestrated onboarding checklist focused on caching / batching / streaming + telemetry for renewal-risk signals. Sharing for quick sync.

Raj Patel: Can you paste the short checklist? Want to include in the kickoff slide.

Maria Chen: Sure — high level run-through: 
- Stage 0 (prep): confirm model pins, collect sample prompt set, set regen budget.
- Stage 1 (seed cache): pre-populate cache with top-50 intents (ttl=24h), enable KV prefix caching for session keys.
- Stage 2 (ramp): small warm pool (5–10 workers), start at 10 qps burst with client-side jitter (±20%).
- Stage 3 (stream): enable streaming, set chunk_size=256, client heartbeat ack every 5s to detect stalls.
- Stage 4 (monitor & gates): track token p95, error rate, batch hit rate, and user feedback signals.

Raj Patel: Add telemetry gates so we can automate safe rollbacks: 
- if p95 latency > 350ms for 5m -> reduce batch_budget or drop to smaller model variant
- if batch hit rate < 30% after ramp -> increase prefill depth
- if rerank-fallthrough > 2% -> rollback to conservative context length

Lana Ortiz: @Maria can you drop the exact prefill call? Kevin and I will run it during DB sync.

Maria Chen: Paste below (minimal example):
```
POST /v1/cache/prefill 
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-prod",
  "prompts": ["what's my invoice status?", "list recent orders"],
  "ttl_seconds": 86400,
  "concurrency": 8
}
```

Kevin Wu: I'll execute that after the DB migration completes and tag here.

onboard-bot: Reminder: kickoff call in ~24h — agenda includes batch policy, streaming opt-in, and renewal-risk signals :bell: 

Maria Chen: Ops tips to keep latency predictable: 
- start with batch_budget=50ms to avoid long head-of-line waits
- prefer small, frequent batches over giant queued batches during ramp
- for streaming clients, require idempotency token so replays don't double-bill cache entries
- capture first-10 queries per session as a validation set for quality checks

Raj Patel: Post-go-live cadence: 24h, 72h, and 14d health checks. Flag renewal risk if either: 3+ distinct failed requests in 24h OR >2 negative feedback items labelled `quality:low`.

Lana Ortiz: I'll own the 72h health check and send an annotated playbook (screenshots + exact dashboard filters).

Kevin Wu: I'll wire dashboards: latency (p50/p95/p99), total tokens, batch hit rate, streaming drop rate, and a simple composite "health_score". Will post links when ready.

Maria Chen: Thanks — if anyone hits blockers DM me. Small ask: when you run the prefill please include a short `prefill-results.json` output so we can track hit rate over time. :thumbsup:
